goal: Prevent orphan transactions from getting permanently stuck when an announcer peer disconnects
Ensure transactions like CPFP fee-bumps are relayed reliably instead of delayed until eviction
agreement: Early concept support with no open objections

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it fixes an exploitable liveness hole where peers can stall package relay
Prevents attackers from deliberately delaying fee-bumping CPFP transactions across the network

categories.name: tests
